requirements.title: INT8, INT16, INT32, and INT64 encode integer kind availability by storage size
requirements.source: S16.10.2.14 p1 kind values and absence codes; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: INT8, INT16, INT32, and INT64 are default integer scalar named constants whose values are integer kind type parameters for 8-, 16-, 32-, and 64-bit INTEGER storage sizes respectively, or exact negative codes -2 and -1 for absent sizes according to larger-kind availability.

pending.int8-kind-or-negative-code: With INTEGER_KINDS and BIT_SIZE inventory, assert INT8 either names an INTEGER kind whose BIT_SIZE is 8, equals -2 exactly for no 8-bit kind plus a larger supported integer kind, or equals -1 exactly for no supported integer kind of size 8 or larger; mutate target size to 16 and mutate the negative code to the other value.
pending.int16-kind-or-negative-code: With INTEGER_KINDS and BIT_SIZE inventory, assert INT16 either names an INTEGER kind whose BIT_SIZE is 16, equals -2 exactly for no 16-bit kind plus a larger supported integer kind, or equals -1 exactly for no supported integer kind of size 16 or larger; mutate target size to 8 and mutate the negative code to the other value.
pending.int32-kind-or-negative-code: With INTEGER_KINDS and BIT_SIZE inventory, assert INT32 either names an INTEGER kind whose BIT_SIZE is 32, equals -2 exactly for no 32-bit kind plus a larger supported integer kind, or equals -1 exactly for no supported integer kind of size 32 or larger; mutate target size to 16 and mutate the negative code to the other value.
pending.int64-kind-or-negative-code: With INTEGER_KINDS and BIT_SIZE inventory, assert INT64 either names an INTEGER kind whose BIT_SIZE is 64, equals -2 exactly for no 64-bit kind plus a larger supported integer kind, or equals -1 exactly for no supported integer kind of size 64 or larger; mutate target size to 32 and mutate the negative code to the other value.

Processor-dependent numeric values, module extensions, compiler option/version text, team identity, atomic/event behavior, multi-image preconnection, and message text are not asserted.

Fixture authors must re-derive every pending plan from the pinned source. Existing tests and profiles mention ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, CHARACTER_KINDS, INTEGER_KINDS, COMPILER_VERSION text in a test name, and unrelated INT8-style identifiers; this packet records that coverage without rebinding it. requirements.title: Processors choose among multiple integer kinds of the same storage size
requirements.source: S16.10.2.14 p1 multiple-kind sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF474.
requirements.definition: For an INT8, INT16, INT32, or INT64 size supported by more than one integer kind, the selected kind value is processor dependent.

pending.intnn-multiple-kind-selection-processor-: No portable oracle may require a particular positive INT8, INT16, INT32, or INT64 kind value among multiple supported INTEGER kinds with identical storage size; future fixtures assert BIT_SIZE relations and exact negative codes only.
